historical_pattern.summary: Hostile parser input (NUL, oversize) crashes the process. Availability break and often a memory-safety signal.

invariant: A parser must not crash on hostile stdin.
prerequisites: bind.entry is a python file under the target, default parse.py

oracle.success_means: the parser crashed or raised on hostile stdin

severity_rationale: A crash on hostile input is an availability defect and a common path to memory corruption.
